name: DaData API
description: Developer library that wraps the DaData.ru Base, Cleaner and Suggestions REST APIs as injectable Drupal services.
project_description: This module provides integration with the DaData API. It won't do much by itself - it is intended for developers. It exposes three injectable services wrapping DaData's Base API (version, balance, daily usage statistics), Cleaner API (data standardization and correction), and Suggestions API (directory search, find-by-id, nearest-address geolocation, and IP location). Requests are made through Guzzle over HTTPS with the API token sent as an Authorization: Token header and an optional X-Secret header for cleaner/base endpoints. The API key, secret, and request timeout are stored in the dadata_api.settings config object and edited on an admin settings form. Please visit DaData.ru for more information about the service.
